answer_1.quote: We introduce Key Point Hierarchies (KPH) as a novel structured representation of opinion summaries... Organizing the key points in a hierarchy... allows the user to quickly grasp the high-level themes in the summary... This structured output makes KPA results more consumable, informative, and easier to navigate.
answer_1.outputs: Hierarchical opinion summaries (Key Point Hierarchies) consisting of clusters of key points and directed entailment edges

answer_2.quote: We use the F1 measure as defined in Section 4.2.3 as our evaluation metric... For each domain, we consider all the key point pairs in the dataset, and show the Precision/Recall curve and the Area Under the Curve (AUC) for each method.
